pages.text: Reason number one the deep ocean has no property market.

pages.title: The Lair
pages.text: Deep oceans now hide our sunken Kraken Lair, coiled on the seafloor around its sleeping tenant. A Waystone waits nearby — damp, but functional.$(p)Bring water breathing, depth strider, and a will. The Kraken's grip tears apart boats and bravado alike.

pages.title: Spoils & Defense
pages.text: Victory yields Kraken Teeth — Big Bertha's forge demands one — and ink enough to sign your memoirs.$(p)Prefer prevention? Kraken Repellent blocks are real, they work, and your harbor deserves them. Line the docks and sleep soundly.

pages.title: What They Leave Behind
pages.text: The deep pays dividends. The kill drops a key to the lair's $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/vault_heist)sunken vault$() — a guaranteed $(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/armor_trims)Kraken trim template$() inside — plus the odd $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/spell_scrolls)Ice scroll$(). The hide sews a sucker-printed $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/boss_backpacks)backpack$().$(p)And witches with rain overhead and ocean underfoot can call another up by $(l:orespawn_integrations:world_remembers/summoning_rites)rite$(). Reason number two.
